name: codex-float
description: An always-on-top Windows companion for active Codex chats, connection status, and remaining quota.

interface.shortDescription: Active chats and quota at a glance
interface.longDescription: A draggable Windows desktop companion for Codex. Follow working chats, questions, reconnecting and offline states; open any chat with one click. View short-term and weekly quota with reset countdowns. Includes English and Chinese, dark and light themes, adjustable size, and a compact notification icon.
